chapters.title: Where it started
chapters.text: I took my bachelor's and master's degrees in Graphic and UI Design at the Academy of Fine Arts of Macerata, and freelanced for 20 companies, from startups to Fortune 500.

chapters.text: At Mapcreator, in the Eindhoven Tower, I spent four years building cartographic knowledge. I started as the only designer and grew into leading four other designers.

chapters.text: From Den Haag I worked remotely for Superside, a US company, for four years, growing from Senior to Lead. I worked both on their SaaS tool and with the Fortune 500 clients Superside has.

items.title: Turning project management into a brand brain (multi-agents platform)
items.summary: Brand Brain: one shared memory per brand, used by four AI agents, with people making the final call. 42% less churn.
